snippet.title: Epitome MMORPG – Kickstarter Teaser (Launching January 2026)
snippet.description:
Epitome is an immersive action MMORPG you can play during the Kickstarter campaign. It combines classic progression (PvE + open PvP, upgrading, trading) with AI-powered NPCs you can talk to by voice or text chat, and it’s strictly no pay-to-win.

We’re launching with a real, playable pre-alpha so backers can jump in early and help shape development, and we’re building toward a much larger endgame world with sandbox-style systems like guild/faction warfare, territory control, and player housing.

Launching in January 2026!

Subscribe to our channel and join the community:
👉 https://discord.gg/EpitomeGame
👉 https://epitomegame.com/
